name: mangadl
description: Desktop manga/manhwa reader and resilient downloader.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @mangadl/core && npm run build -w @mangadl/sources && npm run build -w @mangadl/persistence && npm run build -w @mangadl/downloader
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @mangadl/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/sources packages/persistence packages/downloader apps/desktop/tsconfig.main.json apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json
